title: Include the rows that point to each row
prompt: Add GET /admin/users in a new file src/routes/admin.ts and register it in src/app.ts. Only users with the "admin" role may call it. It returns every user ordered by email, each with a "notes" property holding all notes that user owns (an empty array when there are none). Load the notes of all users with a single extra database query, never one query per user.
